doc: Runs of the new H2O law (q_min = 0.02 q_max, 2026-11-18) for the source-rate figure sets (source_rate_q002_submit.py). maps = the run's final maps (the chain posts write maps_c5 / c5/maps_ft); old_maps = the old-law counterpart's maps (q_min = 0.2 q_max) for the inspection figure. model_texts: the activity model's description in the captions (null = the softplus text of pub_maps_figures.model_text); {multipliers} is replaced by the fitted slope-bin multipliers. 2026-11-23: + run C_f10_allheld_q002 (the all-held candidate, FINDINGS A23) and model text localnn_allheld.
law_note: new H2O law q_min 0.02 q_max (srcCG's value, the night-side fix of 2026-11-18); every fit and figure before 2026-11-18 used q_min 0.2 q_max (not intended)

model_texts.clipped: Its H2O activity factor is the clipped linear activity A = max(0, Y a + A_s sum_k c_k T_k): Y a the spherical-harmonic expansion (25 coefficients, degree <= 4), T_k the cliff template (slope >= 60 deg; its coefficient c_cliff fitted, >= 0) and the six fine-tuning correction templates ft_c1..ft_c6 of earlier fits (held at 1), A_s the enhancement scale; no slope multipliers and no fine tuning (the D2 export gives the tools this A with multipliers 1). The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.sos: Its H2O activity factor is the sum-of-squares model (option A) A = m_b (|L^T y|^2 / A_s + A_s T) exp(h): y the 25 real spherical harmonics (degree <= 4), L a 25 x 3 lower-trapezoidal coefficient matrix (rank 3), A_s D2's enhancement scale, T the sum of the six held correction templates, m_b the multiplier of the facet's effective-gravitational-slope bin ({multipliers}), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.background: Its H2O activity factor is the background model (option B) A = m_b (A_bg A_orig + s ln(1 + exp(L/s))) exp(h): A_orig the srcCG activity map, A_bg the fitted background level (lower bound 1e-2), L = Y a + A_s T (the spherical-harmonic expansion, 25 coefficients, plus the six held correction templates times D2's enhancement scale A_s), s = 1e-5 A_orig, m_b the multiplier of the facet's effective-gravitational-slope bin ({multipliers}), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.logspread: Its H2O activity factor is the log-spread model (option D) A = m_b (A_orig exp(u) + A_s T) exp(h): A_orig the srcCG activity map, u = Y a / A_s the spherical-harmonic expansion (25 coefficients) over D2's enhancement scale A_s (spread penalty f 0.1), T the sum of the six held correction templates, m_b the multiplier of the facet's effective-gravitational-slope bin ({multipliers}), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.localnn_tplon: Its H2O activity factor is the local non-negative basis (option C) A = m_b (sum_j c_j phi_j + A_s sum_k ft_ck) exp(h): phi_j piecewise-linear hat functions of a coarse triangulation of the surface with coefficients c_j >= 0 (smoothness penalty f, multiplier penalty f_m), ft_ck the six held correction templates times D2's enhancement scale A_s, m_b the multiplier of the facet's effective-gravitational-slope bin ({multipliers}), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.localnn_tploff: Its H2O activity factor is the local non-negative basis (option C, templates off) A = m_b (sum_j c_j phi_j) exp(h): phi_j piecewise-linear hat functions of a coarse triangulation of the surface with coefficients c_j >= 0 (smoothness penalty f, multiplier penalty f_m), m_b the multiplier of the facet's effective-gravitational-slope bin ({multipliers}), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
model_texts.localnn_allheld: Its H2O activity factor is the local non-negative basis (option C, templates off) with every slope multiplier held at 1, A = (sum_j c_j phi_j) exp(h): phi_j piecewise-linear hat functions of a coarse triangulation of the surface with coefficients c_j >= 0 (smoothness penalty f 10; no slope dependence and no multiplier penalty), h the accumulated per-facet fine-tuning term. The emitted H2O flux is F_H2O = q_H2O A; the code gives units only to F (m^-2 s^-1), not separately to q and A.
